literal: Vigilance, learning, possessing decisiveness, these three depart not from those who rule the earth.
translation: Vigilance, learning, and decisiveness—these three qualities never depart from those who rule the earth.
modern: காலம் தாழ்த்தாத சுறுசுறுப்பு, சிறந்த கல்வி, முடிவெடுக்கும் துணிவு ஆகிய இந்த மூன்றும் நாட்டை ஆளும் தலைவர்களிடம் இருந்து விலகாமல் இருக்க வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines three essential qualities for a successful ruler. 'தூங்காமை' means vigilance or acting without delay, 'கல்வி' is continuous learning, and 'துணிவுடைமை' is the boldness to make firm decisions. The poet states that these three traits must never depart ('நீங்கா') from those who govern the land, as they are the foundation of effective leadership.
